messages:
zoe: Quick launch ops/design ask — we need a compact "Localization + Variant" playbook for the webinar creative. Deliver: one 16:9 slide master, 3 benchmark microtiles, routing icon SVG, hero thumbnail (600x360), + social cards (1200x628, 800x800). Include EN/ES/DE copy layers and dark mode. First pass by Tue pls.
ashley: Can do. Do you want separate language pages or a single file with variants?
zoe: Single Figma file with dedicated pages per language + a tokens page. Make components for headline/subhead/cta so ops can swap.
marco: Legal reminder: avoid superlatives. Use "low-latency" / "cost-efficient". Add a small footnote frame with test conditions.
azs: ping @brand-ops for logo sizing: logomark min 72px and tone must match token palette.
brand-ops: Confirmed. Also require 4.5:1 contrast for primary text and alt-text for every asset. Provide a CSV-friendly asset manifest for ingestion.
ashley: noted. Chart question: show p50/p95 with callouts or single callout?
zoe: p50 main callout, p95 secondary smaller. For social variants prefer single bold number + mini sparkline.
marco: I'll upload translations CSV and the devbench sample CSV to drive: https://drive.redwood/launch/loc_pack.csv and https://drive.redwood/launch/devbench_sample.csv — mark numbers as "representative" if placeholders.
ashley: GIFs? any motion specs?
zoe: If we do GIFs, keep them subtle (sparkline animate), 3 frames, <2MB, provide static fallback PNG. Reduced-motion variants required.
ashley: will include reduced-motion SVGs and PNG fallbacks. Export presets: PNG 1920x1080, 1200x628, 800x800, 600x360; SVG icons. Naming: `launch_{lang}_v1_{asset}_{w}x{h}.png`.
ops-bot: Reminder for ops mapping: include columns in manifest: filename, width, height, variant_key, alt_text, copy_key, legal_note, utm_content. Example utm pattern: `?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_content=H1A`.
zoe: Good — also include short copy variants per slide (title + 2-line deck hero) and alt-text snippets for CMS.
ashley: ETA: I'll push a branch in the shared file and drop sample exports by Mon evening. Figma branch name will be `loc_playbook-4525009876`.
figma-bot: Created file 'Launch / Loc + Variant Playbook' and branch 'loc_playbook-4525009876'  https://www.figma.com/file/locplay/abcd-4525009876
marco: I'll review the microcopy and legal note once files are uploaded. Zoe  ping me when ready for sign-off.
zoe: Thanks team. If design needs placeholder numbers, use the devbench CSV and mark frames as "sample". Will trigger brand/legal review once branch is ready. :sparkles:
